'''Golden Trumpet''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Any Phase''': Put 1 [[Sanity token]] from the [[bank]] on Golden Trumpet to avoid losing 1 [[Sanity]].  If there are 3 Sanity tokens on it, discard Golden Trumpet.

'''Price''': $5
